title: Spanish Sofrito with Slow-Cooked Onion, Peppers and Tomato
summary: A deeply savoury base of slow-cooked onion, peppers and tomato, cooked down until sweet, jammy and intensely flavoured.

ingredients.item: medium leek, white and light green parts, washed and finely diced (optional)
fine sea salt or table salt
ripe tomatoes, halved and grated, skins discarded

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat 120 ml olive oil in a heavy saucepan over medium-high until shimmering.

steps.title: Soften
steps.text: Add the garlic, onions, both peppers and leek with a pinch of the salt, and cook, stirring, until the vegetables release their liquid and begin to colour on the base, about 10 min.

steps.title: Caramelise
steps.text: Lower the heat to medium-low and cook, stirring and scraping often, until very soft, sweet and deep golden, about 45 min.

steps.title: Add
steps.text: Stir in the grated tomato, bay leaf, paprika and remaining salt, and cook until the tomato has reduced to a thick, jammy paste, 10-15 min.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 min, then remove the bay leaf.

tips: Resist the urge to rush the onions and peppers; the long, slow cooking is what builds the deep, sweet flavour.
Stir and scrape the base of the pan often once the heat is lowered, so nothing sticks or burns.
Make a large batch and freeze it in portions, as it's just as useful as a flavour base for many other dishes.
storage: Once cooled, keep covered in the fridge for up to 5 days, or freeze in portions for longer storage. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
